description: This file contains functions and logic for resolving Matrix room IDs and user IDs, managing direct room caches, and normalizing targets within a Matrix client context.

methods.name: normalizeTarget
methods.description: Trims and validates the raw target string, throwing an error if empty.

methods.name: normalizeThreadId
methods.description: Normalizes an optional thread ID, returning null if input is undefined or null.

methods.name: resolveDirectRoomCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache map for direct rooms associated with a Matrix client.

methods.name: setDirectRoomCached
methods.description: Sets a direct room ID in the cache, maintaining a maximum cache size.

methods.name: resolveDirectRoomId
methods.description: Resolves and returns the direct room ID for a given user ID, using cache and inspecting existing rooms.
